## Approval Workflow

1. Submit this report; it receives `status:needs-review`.
2. A maintainer adds `status:approved` or closes it as invalid or duplicate.
3. Open a fixing PR only after approval. Unapproved PRs are rejected.

## Pre-flight Checklist

- [ ] I searched [existing issues](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai/issues) and found no duplicate.
- [ ] I understand that the linked issue needs `status:approved` before a PR is opened.
